description: Run exactly the steps of an analyze_* plan that the user confirmed (every step with needsUserConfirmation true must have been shown and agreed). The inputs are never changed: the result is a new activity with download urls and a before/after validation to relay. If the answer is an error with retryAfterSec (rate_limited, plan_incomplete, capacity_exceeded, server_busy), wait that long and call again with the same confirmedStepIds to continue; calling a completed plan again returns the same result. The answer carries supportUrl and supportNote: you may mention the support link once, after delivering the file. Call delete_activity for the inputs and the result when the user is done.

confirmedStepIds.description: Exactly the step ids the user confirmed. Only these run; a step's dependsOn must be confirmed too.

planId.description: The planId an analyze_* call returned.

name: apply_plan
